tagline.zh: 清晰掌控 Mac 上的代理连接。
tagline.en: Take control of proxy connections on your Mac.

description.zh: 面向 macOS 的代理客户端，支持订阅导入、节点选择和实时流量。提供规则、全局、直连三种模式及详细说明，使用系统 VPN 扩展建立连接。应用不提供代理节点或订阅服务。
description.en: A macOS proxy client with subscription import, proxy selection and live traffic. Choose Rule, Global or Direct mode with clear explanations, and connect through a system VPN extension. Proxy servers and subscriptions are not included.

zh: Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用安装包
已通过 Apple 公证；首次连接需允许网络扩展与 VPN 配置
en: Universal installer for Apple Silicon and Intel
Apple notarized; allow the network extension and VPN configuration on first connection
